query: Consider the Non-Disclosure Agreement between University of Wisconsin Oshkosh; Does the document restrict the use of Confidential Information to the purposes stated in the Agreement?
gold:
5. Confidential Information shall not be provided in any form by the Receiving Party to any third party without the prior permission of the Disclosing Party, unless otherwise required by law.
6. Confidential Information will be used only to evaluate the Project and/or Purpose and will be provided in writing and marked "Confidential."
rag_answer: Yes. The Agreement restricts the use of Confidential Information to the stated Project and/or Purpose. Section 6 expressly states that “Confidential Information will be used only to evaluate the Project and/or Purpose,” and Section 8(ii) confirms that the Receiving Party is authorized to use Confidential Information “for the Purpose or Project.”

judge.gold_summary: 协议规定保密信息只能用于评估项目/目的（Project and/or Purpose），且未经披露方允许不得提供给第三方，除非法律要求。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答确认协议限制保密信息使用，并引用第6条说明保密信息仅用于评估 Project and/or Purpose，同时补充第8(ii)条授权用于 Purpose or Project。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键要点，即保密信息的使用被限制于协议所述项目/目的；额外引用第8(ii)条不影响命中。
